text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she made her debut safely, Meisho 
Doto collapses, perhaps as the price of 
getting far too excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A shocking truth was revealed in the 
infirmary she was carried into. Meisho 
Doto's body had not yet reached its 
"bloom" phase.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An "awakening" is a growth period for an 
Umamusume. Running too hard before it 
happens, no wonder she collapsed...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, not knowing how to give up, 
Meisho Doto decided to steadily build up 
her race record without pushing herself 
too hard.
